what_happened.line: The Select Board voted on a 20-year solar purchase and sale agreement for solar credits; the minutes do not record how members voted.
The board voted on an all-alcohol license transfer for Embers Pizzeria and a change of manager for Shawn Patrick's after hearings; vote counts were not audible.
The board voted to declare 17 and 23 West Street available for disposition; the minutes do not record the tally.
The town manager said a certified nutritionist for the Council on Aging will not be in the FY21 budget.
The board voted on 2020 license renewals (alcohol, auto dealer, limousine, common victualler, miscellaneous) and ratified a reserve police officer appointment.

why_it_matters: The solar agreement sets how the town buys energy credits for 20 years, so its pricing and savings terms bear on the town's future electricity costs.

Declaring West Street properties available for disposition is a step toward a sale or other transfer of town-owned land, and the FY21 budget decision on the nutritionist shapes which Council on Aging services are funded.
watch_next: The FY21 budget as it develops, including the new town positions questioned in public comment and the Council on Aging nutritionist position left out.
Any later Select Board action on 17 and 23 West Street after the availability declaration.
